builds.name: Bountiful Harvest: drain plus missing-health finish
builds.summary: Investigate high one complete Bountiful Harvest channel output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one complete Bountiful Harvest channel output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The channel deals 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.45 AP magic per second for two seconds, then 12/14.5/17/19.5/22% enemy missing HP magic at the end. Rank-5 timed drain nominally totals 360 + 0.9 AP; the final 22% term must use the missing HP at its actual damage time, after prior damage.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 10000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 50%, observation 2s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop observed damage at death, cap observed healing at missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed and Riftmaker legally pre-ramped. One isolated 10000-max-HP champion starts at 50% health and remains tethered for the full two seconds. No Q/E/R damage inside the measurement, no extra victims and no channel interruption. Record target HP before the final packet.

kitEvidence.formula:
Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus [12 / 14.5 / 17 / 19.5 / 22]% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores [25 / 32.5 / 40 / 47.5 / 55]% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.
